lead_raw_text:
The structure of Rb12Sc4Cl24 (reduced formula Rb3ScCl6) adopts the cubic space group Fm-3m (No. 216) and contains 40 atoms per unit cell across four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Sc and one Rb orbit each adopt octahedral coordination by six Cl neighbors, while a second Rb orbit has eight Cl neighbors and Cl centers have two neighbors (one Rb and one Sc). The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component, and validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-sharing Sc–Sc and Sc–Rb octahedra, plus corner- and edge-sharing Rb octahedra.
